quotes.quote: PR #121 changed `_schedule_unknown_device_discovery` from cancel-and-reschedule to skip-while-pending, but the burst test still asserted the old cancel behavior.
The mismatch only surfaced once both PRs landed on main, since each was tested against the other's pre-merge base.
Updates the test to assert the actual debounce behavior: a burst collapses into one scheduled run, no cancel.
